The test checks that continuation argument text and start events remain associated with the corresponding call.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes **Change:** Bug fix **Possibly related PRs** - [looplj/axonhub#2686](https://github.com/looplj/axonhub/pull/2686): Emits Responses argument deltas with an index but without a repeated call ID; this PR restores the ID by index. - [looplj/axonhub#2707](https://github.com/looplj/axonhub/pull/2707): Assigns indexes to unindexed tool-call fragments and continues fragments by call identity; this PR uses indexes to recover IDs in later fragments. **Suggested reviewers:** `looplj`
